Source [ORACLE]:WITH rollover_excluded_mbrs AS (

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.member_profile mp 
  ON hc.member_profile_id_nh=mp.member_profile_id_nh 

  WHERE hc.benefit_begin_dt BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND hc.benefit_end_dt BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND hc.enrollment_status_id IN (200004,
  200005) 

  AND sep_reason<>'SEP_ROL' 

  UNION ALL 

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mbi,
  mbr.member_profile_id_nh,
  mbr.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrexcep.member mbr

  INNER JOIN mbrexcep.member_error mbr_er 
  ON mbr.member_id_nh=mbr_er.member_id_nh 
  AND mbr_er.error_status_id=170105 

  INNER JOIN mbrexcep.health_coverage hc 
  ON mbr.member_id_nh=hc.member_id_nh 

  WHERE mbr.maintenance_type_code='021' 

  AND TO_DATE(hc.benefit_begin_dt DEFAULT NULL 
  ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD')BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND TO_DATE(hc.benefit_end_dt DEFAULT NULL 
  ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')

  UNION ALL 

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrprofile.member_profile mp

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_begin_dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012026', 'MMDDYYYY') 
  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL 

  AND hc.plan_id='H3551002000'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
  DISTINCT mp.mbi,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  mp.business_id_nh 
  FROM mbrprofile.member_profile mp 

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh 

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.mbr_address ma 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=ma.member_profile_id_nh 

  AND upper(ma.address_type)='RESIDENTIAL'

  AND upper(ma.county)='PIMA' 

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_begin_dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012026', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY') 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL

  AND hc.plan_id LIKE'H3551004%')

 
  SELECT 'ENROLL.MEMBER' AS tbl
  ,COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT
 
  FROM (
  SELECT mp.subscriber_ind,
  '18'AS individual_rel_code,
  '021'AS maintenance_type_code,
  hc.maintenance_rsn_code,
  mp.benefit_status_code,
  mp.medicare_plan_code,
  mp.eligibility_rsn_code,
  mp.cobra_qual_event_code,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS employment_status_code,
  mp.student_status_code,
  mp.handicap_ind,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS date_time_format_qual,
  mp.date_of_death,
  mp.confident_code,
  mp.birth_seq_number,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS enrollment_status,
  mp.member_code,
  0 AS file_detail_id_nh,
  mp.hix_subscriber_id,
  mp.hix_member_id,
  mp.hp_subscriber_id,
  mp.hp_member_id,
  hc.plan_id,
  
TO_DATE('01012027', 'MMDDYYYY')AS elg_begin_dt,
  TO_DATE('12312027', 'MMDDYYYY')AS elg_end_dt,
  mp.maint_effective_dt,
  mp.member_profile_id_nh,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS prem_withhold_source,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS prem_direct_pay,
  mp.mbi,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS esrd,
  mp.medicaid,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS part_d_sub_ind,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS deemedind,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS subsidypercentage,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS deducted_flg,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS deemed_reason_code,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS lis_copay_lvl_id,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS deemed_copay_lvl_id,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS partd_opt_flg,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS spouse_employment_status,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS emailoptin,
  
mp.business_id_nh,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))AS email_optin_materials,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS phoneoptin,
  'N' AS generate_tc_flg,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS original_prem_direct_pay,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS org_id_nh,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS employee_id,
  MP.broker_id_card_access,
  
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS textoptin 

  FROM mbrprofile.member_profile mp

  INNER JOIN mbrprofile.health_coverage hc 
  ON mp.member_profile_id_nh=hc.member_profile_id_nh

  WHERE hc.enrollment_status_id=200004 

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_begin_dt) BETWEEN TO_DATE('01012026', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')

  AND trunc(hc.benefit_end_dt)=TO_DATE('12312026', 'MMDDYYYY')
  AND
hc.term_rsn_code IS NULL

  AND(mp.member_profile_id_nh NOT IN( 
  SELECT member_profile_id_nh 
  FROM rollover_excluded_mbrs)

  OR mp.mbi NOT IN( 
  SELECT nvl(mbi, '~') AS mbi 
  FROM rollover_excluded_mbrs))

  AND mp.business_id_nh='110' )

  ,COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT 
  FROM enroll.member a

  INNER JOIN enroll.trans_set_header b
